title: p1v's Blood Mod
description: Adds blood particles, mist, decals, blood pools, and bleeding effects to make Minecraft combat more visceral and atmospheric.
body:
# **Features**

## Impactful blood particle effects
_When entities are attacked, blood particles will burst out from the hit position, making combat feel more responsive and satisfying._![Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f23c3f239c0ad9fdd63b7d8c7247ffd9159ab19e_0.webp)

## Blood mist effects
_Attacks also generate a subtle blood mist, adding a more realistic and atmospheric visual effect._![Blood Mist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d987da6ab0e6db2f3b37e68a08de4641a14b5226_0.webp)

## Physical blood splatter particles
_Blood splatter particles can attach to blocks as decals. If the block they are attached to is destroyed, the blood decal will naturally fall down and reattach to another surface below._

## Blood pool on death
_When an entity dies, a blood pool will gradually form beneath it, spreading and gathering into a pool over time._

## Bleeding state for low-health entities
_When an entity’s health drops below 20%, it enters a bleeding state. Blood particles will drip around it, and if it stays on the same block for a while, blood stains may appear on that block. These stains will gradually disappear over time after the entity leaves._
